categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches Wallet label, modifies DescriptorScriptPubKeyMan in src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.cpp, and adds functional wallet tests.
categories.rationale: Fixes wallet state inconsistency where keys below range_start are treated as owned until restart, while preventing excessive key derivation DoS. When importing descriptors with range [N, M], the wallet previously expanded keys starting from 0, allowing up to 2^31 keys to be derived and causing rescanned transactions below N to lose ownership upon wallet restart. It also eliminates redundant descriptor expansions and dramatically speeds up non-zero range imports (e.g. 19.5s to 0.09s in author benchmarks).
